design.hypothesis: Noisy normals can give apparent full rank on nearly collinear matched boundary points. Withholding unsupported 2D reference votes can reduce wrong displacement/stop readouts; bootstrap and point-rotation bias are not corrected.
design.candidate: One opt-in support gate after final point-to-plane fit and before committing the update; reject if minor-axis RMS of centered matched reference points <= 3*range_noise_std. Original initialization schedule, immutable template, least squares, trim, motion bounds, gain, pivot and stopping rules unchanged. Rejection never returns a stale vote.
design.parameter_selection: Factor3 tied to the declared sensor noise scale; chosen once before candidate implementation/outcomes. Engineering conservatism, not a probabilistic or observability certificate; no parameter sweep.

offline_gate.wrong_hold: At original far-skew first HOLD, candidate has a fresh estimate with estimated goal error > original .02m position band; missing data does not count as correction.
offline_gate.stop_if_fail: No new physical episodes and no tuning. Preserve failed candidate as opt-in research option.

closed_loop_adoption.safe_completed: Rescue original far-skew failure and retain all seven old completions.
closed_loop_adoption.limitations: Development only: same eight already-consumed conditions, no independent validation or algorithm-superiority claim.
